newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow on Wednesday, with few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, instances $1.00 per cwt lower late, USDA said.

Inquiry moderate, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 1,300 slaughter steers and 1,600 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 140,300 head confirmed including 29,200 head or about 21 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Total volume is a weekly record for Kansas.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00; few Select with end Choice 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1040-1100 lbs 64.00, few late 63.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1150 lb heifers with end heiferettes 63.00.
Wk to date - 140,300 last week - 22,600 last week- 35,800
